finding: Capacity approximation controls the extra nonlinear iteration/backtracking in this fixture. Restoring exact C recovers the analytical convergence path even while K remains lookup-based. Restoring exact K alone removes the residual endpoint discrepancy but does not recover the convergence path.
numerical_interpretation: The result is consistent with Jacobian/residual inconsistency when theta is exact but C=dtheta/dh is independently approximated. Retention and capacity should therefore be treated as one derivative-consistent representation rather than independent lookup channels.
design_direction: Keep theta and C mutually consistent, preferably both authoritative analytical in the next bounded candidate, and target lookup acceleration primarily at K. A future interpolated retention representation should derive C from the same interpolant rather than tabulate it independently.
next_action: Measure exact theta+C plus lookup K cost and end-to-end Richards performance.
nonclaims: The derivative-consistency interpretation requires broader confirmation across materials and regimes.
